# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy_sets (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy_sets" "example_zero_trust_cws_policy_sets" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  deployment_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
  name = "name"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `deployment_id` (String) Filter to policy sets attached to this deployment
- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `name` (String) Filter by policy set name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".

### Read-Only

- `result` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result))

<a id="nestedatt--result"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String) Optional free-form description.
- `exclude_workload_ids` (Set of String) IDs of workloads that exclude matching requests. Exclusions take precedence.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `include_workload_ids` (Set of String) IDs of workloads that include matching requests. Empty includes all requests before exclusions.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account
- `policies` (Attributes Set) Member policies and their per-membership enforcement mode (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--result--policies))
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags attached to this policy set
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--result--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `result.policies`

Read-Only:

- `enforce` (Boolean) Whether this policy should enforce when it matches. False keeps the policy attached for non-enforcing evaluation.
- `policy_id` (String) ID of the member policy
